description: This file contains functions for normalizing and processing JSON schemas related to agent tools, including handling provider-specific quirks and schema merging.

methods.name: extractEnumValues
methods.description: Extracts enum values from a JSON schema object, handling 'enum', 'const', 'anyOf', and 'oneOf' constructs.

methods.name: mergePropertySchemas
methods.description: Merges two property schemas, combining enum values and common attributes.

methods.name: hasTopLevelArrayKeyword
methods.description: Checks if a schema record has an array keyword ('anyOf', 'oneOf', 'allOf') at the top level.

methods.name: getFlattenableVariantKey
methods.description: Returns 'anyOf' or 'oneOf' if present at the top level of a schema record.

methods.name: getTopLevelConditionalKey
methods.description: Determines the top-level conditional key ('anyOf', 'oneOf', 'allOf') in a schema record.

methods.name: hasTopLevelObjectSchema
methods.description: Checks if a schema record has 'type' and 'properties' at the top level with no conditional key.

methods.name: isObjectLikeSchemaMissingType
methods.description: Checks if a schema resembles an object schema but is missing the 'type' attribute.

methods.name: isTypedSchemaMissingProperties
methods.description: Checks if a schema has 'type' but lacks 'properties', indicating a missing properties object.

methods.name: isTrulyEmptySchema
methods.description: Checks if a schema object is empty (has no keys).

methods.name: normalizeToolParameterSchema
methods.description: Normalizes a tool parameter schema, handling provider-specific quirks and flattening union schemas.

methods.name: normalizeToolParameters
methods.description: Normalizes the parameters of an agent tool, preserving metadata.

methods.name: cleanToolSchemaForGemini
methods.description: Deprecated function for cleaning schemas for Gemini provider.
